title: Dex App is losing connection to aaps 2.7.0 several times a day
symptom: Dex App is losing connection to AAPS 2.7.0 several times a day. The only way to repair is to toggle Bluetooth off/on, then AAPS receives values again immediately. Even the BT Watchdog doesn't help. This happens several times for more than an hour.
cause: Possible cause is the NSClient crashing, as one user reported that turning off NSClient resolved the issue, and the maintainer acknowledged that if NSClient is crashing it could theoretically cause the problem.
fix: One user reported that turning off the NSClient in AAPS resolved the issue. Another user mentioned a fix described in a link, but the details are not provided in this thread.
evidence_quote: since yesterday I turned off the NSClient in AAPS. since then I have no more problems with missing blood glucose values. is it possible that it is due to the NSClient?
